svg.title: The communication double flash
svg.desc: Sender A1 has an orange border and TX B1. Receiver B1 has a green border and RX A1. Both flash on, off, on, then off over 625 milliseconds.

g.text: One illustrated event. Two visible endpoints.
Orange = TX / sending Green = RX / receiving These examples are scripted events.
The TX/RX footer remains during the 125 ms dark gap. After 625 ms, the state’s normal footer returns.
A green flash is not an acknowledgement, a trust score, or evidence that the receiver changed its decision.
